_about: HO-040 Roster Russian Roulette. World units are metres; the table top is at y 0.75, the dealer sits at z -0.95 facing the camera, Daniel is LEFT (x negative), Nik is RIGHT. Edit these numbers when a picture layer drops into assets/; no code change needed.

room.note: 16:9 empty room plate; replaces the 3D back wall when present

dealer.note: alpha cut-out, seated, right arm out, revolver aiming image-right. u/v are picture fractions (0-1 from the top-left) for the muzzle and the grip; the 3D arm and revolver stay for the close-ups

flash.note: additive sprite at the muzzle; procedural flash until it exists

cylinder.note: not used by the 3D screen (the cylinder is a real 3D model); kept for the HUD dial if Team G wants one
